title: UPDATE: Databricks Integrates Jev 1.14 to Speed Up AI Decisions by 200x
summary:
Real-time record classification and scoring now take between 70 and 500 milliseconds for users of the Lakehouse data platform. This latency reduction follows the deployment of TypeSafe's Jev 1.14, a structured decision model that Databricks says is 20 to 200 times faster and up to 400 times cheaper than standard large language models. The model is integrated via ai_classify and ai_decide functions, with security and monitoring handled by Unity Gateway.

Unlike traditional LLMs, Jev focuses on returning calibrated probabilities for classification rather than generating text. Version 1.14 also launched on OpenRouter, where pricing is held at $0.042 per million input tokens with no cost for output. This update introduces experimental multimodal capabilities, including image inputs, a new box API, and expanded context windows.

selectedTweets.text:
Decide faster. TypeSafe's Jev-1.14 is now available on Databricks.

Jev isn't a text generator. It's a structured decision model. It classifies, scores, and returns calibrated probabilities, resolving each decision in roughly 70 to 500 milliseconds, 20 to 200 times faster and up to 400 times lower cost than standard LLMs. For Databricks customers, that means real-time decisioning across millions of records at a fraction of the cost.

With our frictionless access, you can get started testing Jev right away. Put Jev to work directly on the data in your Lakehouse through ai_classify and ai_decide. Tag documents, route records, and score decisions across millions of rows, with every call governed, monitored, and secured by Unity Gateway.

Try Jev  → https://t.co/VRTleKZ2KE
